status: New exploratory representation proposed after the stock-mixture results; not a preregistered confirmatory analysis
within_sector: Retain the existing individual-stock five-day residual-vector analyses, all three sectors, all ten draws and all strides
between_sector: One sector per observation; ascending order statistics of its five stock-level weekly residual scores
weekly_score: sum of the five daily estimated standardized GARCH residuals divided by sqrt(5); not a cross-stock average and not a separately fitted weekly GARCH innovation
fit_period: 2015-2017; same fixed fitted GARCH parameters and same historical stock cohort
schedule: Reuse the previous between-sector calendar dates and sector labels in every draw/stride. Ignore its selected stock; observe all five stocks in that sector on that block.
training: All 116 jointly complete fitting blocks per sector. Common fitting-only coordinate standardization.
classifier_seed: Reuse the former between-sector classifier seed for the matching draw, without outcome-dependent reselection
permutations: Reuse the former between-sector permutation seed for the matching draw and stride; identical observed sector labels yield the same permutation labels
multiplicity: Recompute four-question Holm within each method/draw/stride using the three retained within-sector p-values and the new sorted-vector between-sector p-value
scope: Preserves selected-sector order-statistic distributions including cross-stock dependence information; stock identity is intentionally removed by sorting. This is a different hypothesis from equality of individual-stock mixtures.
inference: Exploratory only. Existing failed calibration does not validate the new representation; no claim of exact level, stock equality or confirmed sector difference.
selection: Do not change primary draw, spacing, stocks, dates or feature definition after seeing new p-values. Preserve all old results. Raw returns remain descriptive.
